name: mining-governance
description: AI-based Smart Mining Governance & Compliance System

scripts.dev:api: cd services/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.worker:reminders: cd services/api && uv run celery -A app.jobs.celery_app:celery_app worker --beat --loglevel=info
scripts.migrate: cd services/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.seed: cd services/api && uv run python -m app.db.seed
